Function practice:
```{r}
round(3.14159)
round(3.14159, digits = 2)
print(rep(5,7))
print(rep(x=5, times=7))
```
Variable practice:
```{r}
x = 532.5
y = "Hello"
z = TRUE
print(paste(x,",", y,",", z))
print(paste (class(x),",", class(y),",", class(z)))
```
Variables and vectors:
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
ID_1="CX1"
ID_2="CX2"
Treated_1=TRUE
Treated_2=FALSE
num_cells_before_1=5415
num_cells_before_2=8123
num_cells_after_1=1432
num_cells_after_2=7543
IDs = c(ID_1, ID_2)
Treated = c(Treated_1, Treated_2)
cells_before = c(num_cells_before_1, num_cells_before_2)
cells_after = c(num_cells_after_1, num_cells_after_2)
print(paste(IDs, Treated, cells_before,cells_after))
```
```{r}
all_my_pets <- c("dog", "horse", "guinea pig", "chicken", "cat")
my_favourite = all_my_pets[4]
print(my_favourite)
```
Data Frames:
```{r}
Cell_table = tibble(cell_ID = IDs, treated = Treated, num_cells_before = cells_before, num_cells_after = cells_after)
gt(Cell_table)
```
CSV import:
```{r}
weather = read_csv("data/weather_data.csv")
gt(weather)
```
